A '''hunting lodge''' existed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]], in the northern continent's [[Olankur]] region. By the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the [[Hunting/Legends|hunting]] lodge had been left abandoned for some time; a layer of dust caked the top of lodge's rough table and other flat surfaces, and a number of [[Death/Legends|dead]] [[Insect/Legends|insects]] could be found laying on the [[Window/Legends|window]] sills. That same year, not long after the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Declaration of a New Order|rose]] to power and moved to establish an Imperial [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]] on Mandalore, reigning [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|''Mand'alor'']] [[Fenn Shysa]] met with Mandalorian [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] [[Kal Skirata]] at the abandoned lodge to discuss issues concerning the future of Mandalore in the wake of the Empire's presence. The two talked over [[Tihaar/Legends|drinks]], and while Skirata was unable to help Shysa, they both parted amicably.<ref name="ImpCom" />

==Behind the scenes==
The hunting lodge in Olankur first appeared in ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the [[2009]] novel, ''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]'' by [[Author/Legends|author]] [[Karen Traviss]].
